name: Holistic Gaussian Initialization
definition: A strategy to generate dense and accurate initialized 3D Gaussians within seconds for endoscopic scenes, replacing the time-consuming and sparse Structure-from-Motion (SfM) pipeline (e.g., COLMAP) used in standard 3DGS. It works for both binocular and monocular input sequences.
summary: Holistic Gaussian Initialization generates dense 3D Gaussians in seconds using depth estimation, replacing slow sparse Structure-from-Motion pipelines for faster endoscopic scene reconstruction.
